verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's agent/computer docs describe a per-chat tool approval mode set from the chat input menu. They also show pending approvals rendered as tool cards with Allow/Deny buttons, so explicit approval prompts for agent actions are documented. The evidence does not show command allowlists or per-action elevated modes, and it rests only on vendor docs. Missing for 10: command allowlists, per-action opt-in elevated modes, independent or hands-on corroboration of the approval flow.
